//: TASK-N2-A2. Ratcheted extraction debt for packages/core/docs/component-meta.json. Every number may only FALL; validate:component-meta fails when one rises, and tells you to lower it when it drops. Measured at 51dec93 with the uncommitted N1+T1+A1 working tree, over 208 components (144 public-component + 64 compound-part). TASK-R5-O8 re-measured every number at 99b963a and drove the four description ratchets to zero.

unclassifiable.//: Components vue-component-meta could not process at all. Zero today -- the task's <stop_conditions> unclassifiable branch was never reached. A rise means a source change broke extraction for a component, which is exactly the signal this gate exists to give.

unresolvedTypes.//: Member types the extractor printed as unusable -- empty, bare `any`, a leaked `__VLS_*` internal, or an `import(...)` module reference. Zero today. NOT a synonym for 'contains the word unknown': Record<string, unknown> and TreeNode<unknown> are fully resolved and are not counted.

publicComponentsWithoutRecord.//: public-component symbols in the ownership manifest with no metadata record. Zero -- this is the success criterion 'all 144 public components have metadata records', held as a ratchet so it cannot silently regress.

propsWithoutDescription.//: Own props whose declaring member carries no JSDoc. Zero since TASK-R5-O8, down from 63 of 1,712 at 51dec93 (still 63, of 1,798, at 99b963a). 57 of those 63 were the props `defineModel` synthesises -- `modelValue`, `open`, `blocked`, `first`/`layout`/`sortField`/`sortOrder`, ... -- and it turned out they ARE authorable: vue-component-meta reads a JSDoc block written directly above the `defineModel(...)` call, measured on DzInput before a line of it was written. The other six were DzAsyncBoundary (delay/onError/timeout), DzErrorBoundary (onError) and DzFieldArray (min/max). This is a SOURCE gap, not an extraction gap: the pipeline reads the JSDoc that is there.

slotsWithoutDescription.//: Slots with no JSDoc on the DzXSlots member. Zero since TASK-R5-O8, down from 21 of 326. Nine of the 21 needed no prose at all: DzCard and its three sub-parts declared no `defineSlots<...>()`, so their slots were inferred from the template and the documented DzCard*Slots interfaces were dead code nothing read. Declaring them is a type-only change with no runtime effect. The other twelve were authored -- DzAsyncBoundary 3, DzErrorBoundary 2, DzFieldArray 2 in their types files, and DzDataGridBody, the three DzForm* parts and DzThemeProvider in inline `defineSlots<{...}>()` blocks, none of which declared slots before.

eventsWithoutDescription.//: Events with no description from any source. Zero since TASK-R5-O8, down from 106 of 359. Two mechanisms closed it, and both are visible in the totals rather than hidden in this number. (1) The `Dz{Name}Emits` lookup became name-keyed instead of path-keyed: thirteen compound parts declare their emits interface in the PARENT's types file (DzContextMenu.types.ts, not DzContextMenuContent.types.ts, which does not exist), so 25 of the 35 authored gaps -- 24 in a parent types file plus `DzSplitter.layoutChange` behind an `export ... as ...` alias -- were documented prose nothing could reach. The other 10 were authored in TASK-R5-O8. (2) Decision A2-D2: the 71 `update:*` events `defineModel` synthesises have no member anywhere to carry prose, so the extractor synthesises one and stamps `descriptionSource: "model-synthesised"`, counted separately in `totals.eventsModelSynthesised`. Subtract that total from `eventsWithDescription` for the authored count.

exposedWithoutDescription.//: defineExpose members with no description. Zero since TASK-R5-O8, down from 26 of 26 -- every exposed member in the catalog was undocumented. The prose that existed sat on the defineExpose() CALL, where no extractor can attribute it to a member; vue-component-meta does read a JSDoc written on the object-literal PROPERTY inside the call, which is where all 27 now live (26 + DzAccordion's revealItem, newly extractable).

publicComponentsWithoutExample.//: public-component symbols with no usable story to draw a real example from. Exactly one: DzThemeProvider, which has no stories file at all -- it is the only public component in the catalog without one. get_component_example returns an explicit 'no example is published' for it rather than fabricating markup.

componentsWithoutStaticTemplate.//: Components whose primary story's template is not a static string literal, so no paste-ready markup can be sliced out verbatim. 80 of 208, unchanged by TASK-R5-O8, and re-measured there into three populations: 64 compound parts with no stories file at all (by design); DzThemeProvider, which has no stories file either (the publicComponentsWithoutExample ceiling of 1); and 15 public components whose primary story is either `= {}` -- Storybook renders it straight from `args`, so there is no template to slice (DzIcon, DzEmoji, DzCopyButton, DzIconButton, ...) -- or an interpolated `${...}` template literal the extractor refuses rather than publish half-substituted (DzAccordion, DzFlex, DzGrid, DzMasonry, ...). The primary story SOURCE is still published for all 143 that have a story, so these are answerable, just not one-line-pasteable. Lowering it means writing stories, not metadata -- TASK-R5-O8 <stop_conditions> routes it to story-dod; see owner decision D53.
